name: aqua
description: AQUA, the estate's assistant: one loop for the soul and for every role it clones into. Per-file tool allowlist (tool_policy: tool.action -> ask|auto, supports tool.* globs); auto actions are directly callable, everything else is proposed for a person's approval.

static.reason: Claude LLM provider (pulled from the registry when configured; the estate consents to it when it arrives)

Grok LLM provider (pulled from the registry when configured; the estate consents to it when it arrives)
OpenRouter LLM provider (pulled from the registry when configured; the estate consents to it when it arrives)

attachments.description: Files attached to the task: objects with filename, media_type and base64 data (canonical content blocks are built per provider)

tool_policy.description: Per-tool approval policy overlay ("ask" | "auto") the harness resolved for this turn

max_tokens.description: Completion token cap for the provider call

sub_agents.description: The roles the soul may clone into, provided by the harness. Each becomes a virtual tool named after the role.

name.description: Role name (used as the virtual tool name)

description.description: Tool description shown to the LLM

prompt.description: Full system prompt for the role

tool_policy.description: The role's own tool allowlist ("ask" | "auto"); absent means no tools

catalyst_ref.description: Catalyst reference for this role (resolved by harness)

role.description: Set by the host when the assistant clones into one of its roles: the role's name, which every event of the run then carries.

emit_tag.description: Set by the host on a clone: the tag its events carry back to the parent's stream (role:tool_call_id).

messages.description: Full conversation history including tool_use/tool_result pairs

usage.description: Accumulated token usage across all turns

input.task: List all Rust files in components/ and describe what each does
input.system: You are an agent running inside CYFR, a governed computation platform.
